title: Fitness Class Waiver Checklist
subtitle: Capture class format, instructor, equipment, and exertion condition; confirm participant choice and session completion.
description: Fitness Class Waiver records class format, instructor, equipment, exertion condition, participant choice, and session completion. Fitness Class Waiver evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this fitness class waiver stage-gated verification when staff must document class format and instructor. Reconcile equipment, exertion condition, participant choice, and session completion before the fitness class waiver handoff. Use the class description, instructor credential reference, equipment list, disclosed exertion conditions, modification menu, participant questions, and attendance result. This acknowledgment concerns an instructor-led exercise session with cardio or resistance intensity, repetitions, studio equipment, modification choices, rest, and class completion. Ask the assigned fitness class waiver reviewer to confirm class format against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Participant and class details
sections.guidance: Match the waiver to the named participant, instructor, and session.

fields.label: Guardian name if participant is a minor

sections.title: Waiver element verification
sections.guidance: Verify the participant received each applicable disclosure and choice.

blocks.label: Required waiver elements
items: The participant and exact class or activity are named
Material exertion, equipment, and environment conditions are stated
Instructor guidance and participant safety duties are explained
Modification, rest, or alternative options are available
Questions and an accessible explanation were offered
Participation is voluntary and decline or withdrawal is available
Emergency response and organizer safety duties remain in force
The form does not claim to waive non-waivable rights
Guardian authority is confirmed when the participant is a minor
Participant choice, signature, and date are present
A completed copy or confirmation is offered

sections.title: Questions, limits, and reviewer receipt
sections.guidance: Keep unresolved questions visible before participation.

fields.label: Question, requested explanation, modification, or declined scope

blocks.label: Checklist review
blocks.guidance: Review confirms document completeness, not medical clearance.
